citations.assessment: The reciprocal Heilprin heading pins Rabban Gamliel of Yavneh. The Berakhot narrative gives the slave relationship and calls Tavi exceptional and upright.

Gilgulei Neshamot attributes the report generally to Midrash Rabbah. Yoma’s parallel speaks of Canaan’s sons rather than slaves. Preserve Heilprin’s Bereshit Rabbah attribution as qualified until the direct locus is secured.

holds.reason: The verse-centered Bereshit Rabbah comparison does not supply the Tavi wording. The parallel in Yoma says sons of Canaan. Preserve the reported Midrash Rabbah attribution and the different descriptions.

notes.text: The esoteric identity and reduced gematria are specifically attributable to Gilgulei Neshamot. The Yoma parallel gives a different formulation from the received Bereshit Rabbah attribution.
